instructions.start: Please consider whether there have been significant times during the last 12 months during which the following statements applied to you. Then please select the option that best describes how well each statement described you during that period.

items.name: hitopbr_01
items.text: I found it easy to deceive others.

items.name: hitopbr_02
items.text: I deserved special treatment.

items.name: hitopbr_03
items.text: I saw things that were not really there.

items.name: hitopbr_04
items.text: My fantasies felt very real to me.

items.name: hitopbr_05
items.text: I liked having power.

items.name: hitopbr_06
items.text: I felt something was wrong with my body.

items.name: hitopbr_07
items.text: When I had the chance, I chose to be alone rather than with other people.

items.name: hitopbr_08
items.text: My moods were intense and unpredictable.

items.name: hitopbr_09
items.text: My mind was flooded with troubling images of a bad experience.

items.name: hitopbr_10
items.text: I had pains in several parts of my body.

items.name: hitopbr_11
items.text: I felt like I was outside of my body.

items.name: hitopbr_12
items.text: I was happiest when I was alone.

items.name: hitopbr_13
items.text: I found it easy to manipulate others.

items.name: hitopbr_14
items.text: I was bothered by several bodily symptoms (e.g., headache, fatigue or stomach problems) for which there was no clear or sufficient medical explanation.

items.name: hitopbr_15
items.text: I had trouble planning and keeping to schedules.

items.name: hitopbr_16
items.text: I lost things that I needed.

items.name: hitopbr_17
items.text: I was frustrated with having to convince others I had a real illness.

items.name: hitopbr_18
items.text: Even when I was very careful, I worried whether I had done something correctly.

items.name: hitopbr_19
items.text: Reading articles about disease made me worry about my health.

items.name: hitopbr_20
items.text: I paid my bills late or missed other important deadlines.

items.name: hitopbr_21
items.text: I could feel changes in my body.

items.name: hitopbr_22
items.text: I was disgusted with myself.

items.name: hitopbr_23
items.text: I felt on guard and on edge.

items.name: hitopbr_24
items.text: I was a messy person.

items.name: hitopbr_25
items.text: I did things to get others to notice me.

items.name: hitopbr_26
items.text: I noticed small changes to how my body feels.

items.name: hitopbr_27
items.text: Things went best when I told others what to do.

items.name: hitopbr_28
items.text: I heard things that no one else could hear.

items.name: hitopbr_29
items.text: I was never on time.

items.name: hitopbr_30
items.text: I had no interest in romantic relationships.

items.name: hitopbr_31
items.text: Romantic relationships seemed like a hassle to me.

items.name: hitopbr_32
items.text: I said things without thinking.

items.name: hitopbr_33
items.text: People told me I was coldhearted.

items.name: hitopbr_34
items.text: I made decisions quickly without thinking them through.

items.name: hitopbr_35
items.text: I quit tasks that became too challenging.

items.name: hitopbr_36
items.text: I had a hard time asserting myself to others.

items.name: hitopbr_37
items.text: I felt that I did not want to be in a close relationship.

items.name: hitopbr_38
items.text: I had trouble telling whether something really happened or I just imagined it.

items.name: hitopbr_39
items.text: I felt that things around me were not real.

items.name: hitopbr_40
items.text: I liked attracting the attention of others.

items.name: hitopbr_41
items.text: I was afraid that I might suffer from a serious illness.

items.name: hitopbr_42
items.text: I thought a lot about death.

items.name: hitopbr_43
items.text: I bought much more than I needed.

items.name: hitopbr_44
items.text: I was overwhelmed by anxiety.

items.name: hitopbr_45
items.text: I expected to get treated better than others.
